exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
cues: Set the bench to 30–45°; any higher becomes a shoulder press.
Pin shoulder blades back and down with a slight arch.
Lower to upper-chest level with elbows about 45° from your torso.
Press up and slightly in without clanking the dumbbells.
Control 2–3 seconds down, then drive up.
mistakes: Flaring elbows to 90°, which loads the shoulder joint.
Bouncing out of the bottom or cutting the range short.
Lifting hips off the bench to finish reps.

exercises.name: Flat Barbell Bench Press
cues: Grip slightly wider than shoulders, wrists stacked over elbows.
Squeeze shoulder blades together and keep feet planted.
Lower the bar to mid-chest with elbows tucked about 45–60°.
Press up and slightly back towards your face.
Keep glutes on the bench and upper back tight throughout.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest.
Elbows flared straight out to the sides.
Hips lifting off the bench.

exercises.name: Decline Dumbbell Fly
cues: Lock legs in and lie back on a slight decline.
Keep a soft, fixed bend in the elbows.
Open wide until you feel a stretch across the lower chest.
Bring the dumbbells together in an arc, squeezing the chest.
mistakes: Bending and straightening the elbows, turning it into a press.
Dropping the weights too low and straining the shoulders.
Going too heavy and losing the arc.

exercises.name: Cable Crossover
cues: Set the pulleys high and step forward into a split stance.
Lean slightly forward with a soft bend in the elbows.
Pull the handles down and together in a wide arc.
Squeeze for a second where the hands meet, then return slowly.
mistakes: Using body swing to move the weight.
Bending the elbows more as you pull, making it a press.
Letting the cables yank the arms back too fast.

exercises.name: Pec Deck Fly
cues: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height.
Keep your back flat against the pad, chest up.
Bring the handles together with a slight elbow bend.
Squeeze the chest hard, then open slowly to a full stretch.
mistakes: Shoulders rolling forward off the pad.
Letting the stack slam between reps.
Using momentum instead of a controlled squeeze.

exercises.name: Decline Crunch
cues: Hook feet securely and lie back on the decline bench.
Hands across the chest or lightly at the temples.
Curl the ribcage towards the hips, rounding the upper back.
Lower under control, stopping before you fully relax.
mistakes: Pulling on the neck with your hands.
Swinging up using hip flexors instead of the abs.
Dropping back down fast.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
cues: Hang from the bar with shoulders engaged, not dead-hanging.
Raise legs by curling the pelvis up, not just lifting the thighs.
Keep the movement controlled with no swinging.
Lower slowly until legs are straight.
mistakes: Swinging and using momentum.
Only lifting the knees without tilting the pelvis.
Letting grip give out first; use straps if needed.

exercises.name: Trunk Rotation
cues: Sit tall, lean back about 45° with knees bent.
Brace the abs and keep the chest open.
Rotate the shoulders, not just the arms, side to side.
Each side counts as one rep; 20 each side.
mistakes: Just moving the arms while the torso stays still.
Rounding the lower back.
Rushing the reps.

exercises.name: Crunch
cues: Lie back with knees bent and feet flat.
Curl the shoulders off the floor by tightening the abs.
Exhale at the top and squeeze for a second.
Lower slowly with control.
mistakes: Yanking the head forward with the hands.
Sitting all the way up and using hip flexors.
Holding your breath.

exercises.name: Cardio
cues: Pick incline walk, cycle or cross-trainer for 20–25 minutes.
Aim for a pace where you can talk in short sentences.
Keep posture tall; don't hang on the handrails.
Finish with 2 minutes easy to cool down.
mistakes: Holding the treadmill rails, which cuts the work.
Going so hard it ruins recovery for tomorrow's legs.
Skipping it on busy days; even 10 minutes counts.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
cues: Grip just wider than shoulders and lock thighs under the pad.
Lean back slightly with the chest up.
Pull elbows down towards your back pockets.
Bring the bar to upper chest, then return to a full stretch.
mistakes: Pulling behind the neck.
Leaning way back and rowing the weight.
Using the biceps instead of driving with the elbows.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
cues: Hinge at the hips with a flat back, torso about 45° or lower.
Let the dumbbells hang under the shoulders.
Row towards the hips, driving the elbows back.
Squeeze shoulder blades together at the top.
mistakes: Rounding the lower back.
Standing up taller as the set gets hard.
Shrugging the weight up with the traps.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
cues: Sit tall with a slight knee bend and chest up.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs.
Drive the elbows back close to the body.
Squeeze the shoulder blades, then let the arms extend fully.
mistakes: Rocking the torso back and forth.
Rounding the shoulders forward at the end.
Shrugging instead of retracting.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
cues: Support yourself with one hand and knee on the bench.
Keep the back flat and hips square.
Pull the dumbbell towards the hip in an arc.
Lower to a full stretch without twisting.
mistakes: Twisting the torso to lift the weight.
Pulling straight up to the chest with the biceps.
Rounding the back.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
cues: Stand facing the cable with a slight forward lean.
Keep the arms nearly straight with a soft elbow.
Sweep the bar down to the thighs using the lats.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch overhead.
mistakes: Bending the elbows, which turns it into a triceps pushdown.
Using the whole body to swing the weight.
Short range at the top.

exercises.name: Back Extension
cues: Set the pad just below the hip bones.
Cross arms over the chest or hold a plate.
Lower with a flat back, then raise until the body is in a straight line.
Squeeze glutes at the top.
mistakes: Hyperextending past straight at the top.
Rounding the back on the way down.
Moving fast with momentum.

exercises.name: Plank Hold
cues: Elbows under shoulders, forearms on the floor.
Body in a straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze glutes and brace the abs as if about to be punched.
Breathe steadily throughout the hold.
mistakes: Hips sagging towards the floor.
Hips piked up high.
Holding your breath.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
cues: Line the knee up with the machine's pivot point.
Pad sits just above the ankles.
Extend fully and squeeze the quads for a second.
Lower slowly; don't let the stack rest between reps.
mistakes: Kicking the weight up with momentum.
Lifting the hips off the seat.
Partial reps at the top only.

exercises.name: Free Squat
cues: Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Sit hips back and down, knees tracking over toes.
Go as deep as you can with a neutral spine.
Drive up through the whole foot; count all 50 reps.
mistakes: Heels lifting off the floor.
Knees caving inwards.
Rounding the back at the bottom.

exercises.name: Barbell Squat
cues: Bar on the upper traps, hands just outside shoulders.
Brace the core hard before every rep.
Sit down between the hips to at least parallel.
Drive up with knees out and chest up.
mistakes: Knees caving in on the way up.
Good-morning squat: hips rising faster than the chest.
Losing tightness at the bottom.

exercises.name: Leg Press
cues: Feet shoulder-width in the middle of the platform.
Lower until knees are about 90° without the lower back lifting.
Press through the heels and mid-foot.
Stop just short of locking out the knees.
mistakes: Lower back peeling off the pad at the bottom.
Locking the knees hard at the top.
Pressing through the toes.

exercises.name: Walking Lunges
cues: Take a long step; both knees bend to about 90°.
Keep the torso upright and core braced.
Push through the front heel to step into the next lunge.
Each step counts; 30 steps per set.
mistakes: Front knee caving inwards.
Short steps that turn it into a quad-only move.
Leaning the torso far forward.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cues: Bench upright, back flat against the pad.
Start with dumbbells at ear height, elbows slightly forward.
Press up and slightly in until arms are straight.
Lower under control to ear level.
mistakes: Arching the lower back off the bench.
Flaring elbows straight to the sides.
Bouncing the weights at the bottom.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
cues: Slight bend in the elbows, slight forward lean.
Raise the arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lead with the elbows, pinkies slightly up.
Lower slowly over 2–3 seconds.
mistakes: Swinging the body to get the weight up.
Shrugging, letting the traps take over.
Going above shoulder height.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
cues: Stand side-on with the cable at the lowest setting.
Raise the arm out to shoulder height across the body.
Keep tension at the bottom; don't let the stack touch.
Control the way down.
mistakes: Leaning away and using momentum.
Bending the elbow more and more.
Shrugging the shoulder.

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
cues: Face the pad with handles at shoulder height.
Keep a slight bend in the elbows.
Sweep the arms back in a wide arc, squeezing the rear delts.
Return slowly without letting the stack rest.
mistakes: Squeezing the shoulder blades together and using the upper back.
Swinging the weight.
Going too heavy and shortening the range.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shrugs
cues: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides.
Shrug straight up towards the ears.
Hold the top for one second.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
mistakes: Rolling the shoulders in circles.
Bending the elbows to help.
Bouncing the reps.

exercises.name: Face Pull
cues: Rope at upper-chest or face height.
Pull towards the face with elbows high.
Split the rope and rotate the hands back at the end.
Squeeze the rear delts, then return slowly.
mistakes: Elbows dropping low, which turns it into a row.
Leaning back to move the weight.
Going too heavy.

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Biceps Curl
cues: Grip the angled part of the bar, shoulder-width.
Elbows pinned at your sides.
Curl up until forearms are vertical, squeeze the biceps.
Lower slowly to full extension.
mistakes: Swinging the hips to start the rep.
Elbows drifting forward.
Half reps at the top.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
cues: Bench at 45–60°, arms hanging straight down.
Keep the upper arms still and behind the body.
Curl with palms up, squeezing at the top.
Lower to a full stretch.
mistakes: Bringing the elbows forward.
Shortening the bottom stretch.
Using a weight too heavy to control.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
cues: Armpits snug against the top of the pad.
Curl up without lifting the elbows off the pad.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly but stop just short of locking out.
mistakes: Dropping the weight fast at the bottom.
Lifting the shoulders off the pad.
Wrists curling to cheat the weight up.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
cues: Hands about shoulder-width, not narrower.
Tuck the elbows close to the body.
Lower the bar to lower chest.
Press up by straightening the elbows hard.
mistakes: Grip so narrow the wrists bend.
Elbows flaring out.
Bouncing off the chest.

exercises.name: Rope Triceps Pushdown
cues: Elbows pinned at your sides, slight forward lean.
Push down until the arms are straight.
Split the rope apart at the bottom.
Let the forearms rise only to about 90°.
mistakes: Elbows moving forward and back.
Using body weight to push down.
Letting the rope pull the hands up too high.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
cues: Face away from the cable with the rope behind your head.
Keep the elbows pointing forward and close.
Extend the arms fully overhead.
Lower behind the head for a deep stretch.
mistakes: Elbows flaring wide.
Arching the lower back.
Short range of motion.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
cues: Bar close to the legs, soft knees.
Push the hips back while keeping the back flat.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch, about mid-shin.
Drive the hips forward to stand tall.
mistakes: Rounding the lower back.
Bending the knees too much, turning it into a squat.
Bar drifting away from the legs.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
cues: Line the knee up with the machine's pivot.
Pad sits just above the heels.
Curl the heels towards the glutes and squeeze.
Lower slowly to almost straight.
mistakes: Hips lifting off the pad.
Kicking the weight with momentum.
Partial reps.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
cues: Balls of the feet on the edge, heels hanging.
Lower the heels for a deep stretch.
Rise as high as possible onto the toes.
Pause one second at the top and bottom.
mistakes: Bouncing at the bottom.
Bending the knees to help.
Short range of motion.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
cues: Pad snug on the lower thighs, balls of the feet on the platform.
Lower the heels fully for a stretch.
Push up as high as possible.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Bouncing reps.
Rocking the upper body.
Not reaching a full stretch.
